en: Black-and-white panoramic view of a small European village in a hilly rural landscape. The foreground shows a meadow with wildflowers sloping down toward tightly clustered houses with steep gabled roofs, many of them two or three stories and plastered or half‑timbered. A railway line with a small station building and a train runs along the edge of the village. Beyond, patchwork fields, scattered farm buildings, and wooded hills extend into the distance. There is no visible printed caption or handwriting on the image side.
